description: This file defines React components for rendering Markdown content with advanced features such as math support, syntax highlighting, diagram rendering with mermaid, and code block handling in a Next.js project.

classes.name: Mermaid
classes.description: React component for rendering a Mermaid diagram from code, with error handling and viewing options.

methods.name: Mermaid
methods.description: Component to render Mermaid diagrams with error handling and optional viewing in a new window.

methods.name: PreCode
methods.description: Component to parse code blocks, detect Mermaid code, and render diagrams accordingly with debouncing.

methods.name: escapeDollarNumber
methods.description: Utility function to escape dollar signs before digits to prevent LaTeX parsing issues.

methods.name: escapeBrackets
methods.description: Utility to escape brackets in markdown content for LaTeX math rendering.

methods.name: _MarkDownContent
methods.description: Internal React component to render Markdown content with math, syntax highlighting, and link handling.

methods.name: Markdown
methods.description: Main React component to display Markdown content with optional loading state and styling.
